game.title: NieR:Automata
game.blurb: Action RPG from PlatinumGames in which the android 2B fights in a war between machines and humanity, released 2017-03-17. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "NieR:Automata"; the guide is under "NieR: Automata", a stub (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs) with no walkthrough; its subpages are Caught Fish, Controls, Enhancement Items, Materials, Pod Programs, Restorative Items, Support Items and Table of Contents. nier.fandom.com answers the API, with about 62 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "TRAIN" (an internal codename). 30 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden. The first 19 (from "Resuscitated Body" to "The Minds That Emerged") are listed together at the top and sit in the main story chapter. The other 11 hidden ones are listed among the side achievements and were put in "Hidden Extras" by schema position; what they are for is not in the data. RAWG has a separate entry for a "3C3C1D119440927" add-on, but no Steam achievement names it, so it has no chapter.
